Offline-First and Local-First Resilience Given the instability of national internet infrastructure and the remote nature of most South African mines, there is a surge in demand for architectures that function without constant cloud connectivity [cite: 30]. These "local-first" models prioritize on-premise data sovereignty and resilience [cite: 30]. Commercial Implication: By developing "offline-first" mobile and web applications, Veramani can guarantee operational continuity for sites where internet reliability is low. This ensures that data collection and safety monitoring do not halt when connectivity fails, providing a critical safety and operational advantage [cite: 30]. 3.
